draft.heroMessage: Your Trusted Guide in North Idaho and Silver Valley Real Estate
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome to Cindy Carlson Realty. As a full-service real estate agency deeply rooted in Kellogg and the scenic Silver Valley, we are dedicated to making your property journey rewarding and seamless.
draft.tagline: Local Expertise. Genuine Integrity. Exceptional Results.
draft.aboutParagraph: With over 18 years’ experience and a lifetime spent in North Idaho, Cindy Carlson brings not just a wealth of real estate knowledge but a sincere commitment to her clients and the community. Cindy is known for her honest guidance, strong work ethic, and in-depth understanding of the Silver Valley market. Her hands-on approach, extensive credentials, and community involvement ensure that your real estate goals—whether buying, selling, or investing—are met with the highest level of integrity and care.
draft.conciergeLine: Have questions about listings, neighborhoods, or the buying and selling process in the Silver Valley? We're always here to help—reach out any time.
draft.contactLine: Connect directly with Cindy at (208) 512-0078 or cindy@cindycarlsonrealty.com for personalized assistance.
draft.tone: Local, knowledgeable, and approachable, highlighting both real estate expertise and genuine community connection.

sections.title: North Idaho’s Silver Valley
sections.body: Nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains, in the heart of the Panhandle National Forest, the Silver Valley is most noted for its mining heritage, dating back to the 1880s. The Silver Valley is also famous for it’s Ski Resorts ~ Silver Mountain and Lookout Pass; it’s Bike Trails, ATV Trails and The World’s Longest Gondola. The narrow valley, about 40 miles in length, comprises a number of small towns along the South Fork of the Coeur d’Alene River and Interstate 90.

sections.title: Cindy Carlson, Broker, Realtor ® , ABR, CRS, GRI, RSPS, RPAC Major Investor
sections.body: Cindy Carlson, Broker/owner of Cindy Carlson Realty, located in Kellogg, Idaho, is a 18 year residential/commercial real estate veteran. With deep roots to this area, Cindy and her husband Denny, have raised their family and enjoyed this scenic area for over 40 years. After 25+ years as a well known figure at a local dentist office, she decided to take her personal skills and stellar work ethic and turn it into a real estate career.

items.title: 409 Emerald Dr
items.description: EXCEPTIONAL 4 BEDROOM LARGE FAMILY HOME IN A BEAUTIFUL NEIGHBORGOOD STEPS AWAY FROM SILVER MOUNTAIN. Pride of ownership is noticed from the minute you pull into the driveway with decades of maintenance and care. Over 2,100 square feet of livable space, a fully finished basement, large windows throughout, terrific sliding glass doors leading out to the scenic back yard with a large cedar deck to take in the stunning view and ample off street parking including a two car attached garage and a paved driveway.

items.title: 6113 Prichard Creek ST
items.description: QUIET, PEACEFUL, SERENE & AWAY FROM IT ALL just begins to describe this 3 bedroom 1 bathroom home in Historic Murray, Idaho. The drive along the pristine Coeur d'Alene River brings a sense of calm in itself. The RV, the off road vehicles, there's plenty of space for them all in the 1,152 sqft insulated shop.

items.title: 483 Paradise Lane
items.description: THIS ISN'T JUST A PLACE TO LIVE! Tired of ordinary? This one-of-a-kind artist-designed home breaks all the rules - in the best way. With creative spaces, distinctive design & endless character, it's perfect for someone who wants a home that's as original as they are. This isn't just a place to live-it's a place to be inspired. Perfect for artists, entrepreneurs, remote professionals, or anyone searching for a home as unique as they are, this property is a rare opportunity to own something truly unforgettable. If you've been waiting for a home with personality, vision, and soul, this is it. Home is already wired for an elevator! Beyond the main residence this property features a unique additional dwelling unit. Whether you are looking for a rental income, a private guest retreat, an inspiring artist studio, or a peaceful home office, this versatile space is ready to fit your vision. Every corner celebrates individuality, making it the perfect place. Motivated Seller!! for those who apprciate homes with purpose, and limitless potential. OPPORTUNITIES LIKE THIS DO NOT COME ALONG OFTEN. IF YOU HAVE BEEN WAITING FOR A HOME THAT DARES TO BE DIFFIERENT AND INSPIRES YOU EVERY DAY, THIS IS THE ONE. COME AND SEE IT FOR YOURSELF, YOU WON'T FIND ANOTHER QUITE LIKE IT. COME SEE IT YOURSELF.

items.title: 50 S Breeden Ave
items.description: Nicely remodeled manufactured home. Easy access to I-90, Close to all conveniences. White shed in back yard is not included..Lot is leased, rent is $400 month. includes water, sewer, garbage and snow removal. Buyer must get approved by Silver Star Park management (208) 784-1178

items.title: 604 W Cameron Ave
items.description: Very well maintained 4 bedroom, 1 1/2 bath home in a wonderful neighborhood. Views of Silver Mountain from your front yard and quiet solitude while enjoying your back yard. Just minutes from Silver Mountain Resort. Turn the unfinished basement into whatever your needs require. The large open kitchen has plenty of room for a family sized dining table set, a dining hutch, along with a kitchen island with 4 chairs. Main floor laundry is a bonus!

items.title: 301 S Division St
items.description: Here's your opportunity to acquire your own business building with land included. Beautifully redone office which includes spacious lobby/reception area, 4 private offices, a bathroom and storage area. Alley access for private parking for multiple vehicles is behind the building. Great location on a corner lot across from the Post Office for great exposure to your business.

items.title: NKA May Court
items.description: Back on Market thru no fault of owner. This beautiful .80 Lot in Cataldo is zoned for R-2 Multi-family. Close to Coeur D 'Alene with easy access to I90. Possibilities are endless. Water and Sewer hook-up fees are paid. OWN AND LIVE IN AMERICA'S PREMIER OUTDOOR DESTINATION AREA. Seller is related to agent.

items.title: 11 & 13 Kingston WAY
items.description: OVER 6 ACRES OF MOUNTAIN TOP PARADISE LESS THAN 40 MINUTES FROM COEUR D'ALENE. These parcels boast terrific North Idaho views, power and natural gas are close and lots of building options.

draft.heroMessage: Welcoming you to Paonia and the vibrant heart of the North Fork Valley.
draft.welcomeNote: Hello! I’m Bernadette Stech, your dedicated guide to the beautiful communities of Paonia, CO. Whether you’re looking to find your perfect home or learn more about life in our special valley, I’m here to help you every step of the way.
draft.tagline: Discover mountain living at its best.
draft.aboutParagraph: Living in this charming mountain town is a daily delight—think breathtaking views, fresh fruit from your own backyard, friendly neighbors, and an authentic sense of community. After discovering Paonia years ago, I instantly knew I’d found my place. I’d love to help you find yours here, too. Let’s talk about what makes the North Fork Valley unique and how I can help you call it home.
draft.conciergeLine: Ready to explore homes or just want to chat about Paonia life? Call or email me anytime.
draft.contactLine: Reach out to Bernadette Stech at 970-261-5928 or bernadette@paoniarealty.com.
draft.tone: Welcoming, personal, and community-focused, with local insight.

sections.title: Welcome!
sections.body: Located on the western slope of the Rocky Mountains in Colorado, Paonia and the North Fork Valley have something for everyone. A population of 1600 in Paonia and another 4000 in the surrounding North Fork Valley, means small town living at it's best. Both town and the surrounding mesa tops have breathtaking views of the West Elk Mountains and the Grand Mesa . Nearby is the Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park .
